scripts.start:client: tsx packages/aux/bin/auxd.ts & tsx packages/aux/bin/aux.ts; pkill -f auxd
scripts.stop: pkill -f auxd; pkill -f 'packages/server'; pkill -f mpv; echo stopped
scripts.restart:server: npm run build --workspace=packages/server && launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.aux.server && echo 'server restarted'
